module: Flowgraph node "Rally Track Stage Time" (category repeat, timer icon, tag rally). Every frame, emits the onRallyDataUpdated hook with {activeState = stageActive} to signal to the rally system that the stage is active. Copies flow to the output.
notes: Despite its name, the node measures no time: stageTime = os.clockhp() is computed but never used.

work.desc: Emits onRallyDataUpdated (stageActive) and copies the flow.
